## Plan: Fix `MapIterator<string>` missing `.filter` type error

`tokenMap.keys()` returns a `MapIterator<string>`, which only has `.filter` if `esnext.iterator` lib helpers are enabled/targeted — apparently not the case here, so TS falls back to the base iterator type without array methods.

**Fix**
- In [plugins/pantoken/custom-theme-colors/src/index.ts](plugins/pantoken/custom-theme-colors/src/index.ts#L100), spread the iterator into an array before filtering:
  `[...tokenMap.keys()].filter((name) => STATUS_INTENT_TOKEN.test(name))`

This is a one-line, low-risk fix. Since I'm in planning mode I haven't applied it — let me know if you want me to hand this off for implementation, or if you'd rather I just confirm this is the intended approach before you apply it.
